summary: Connect asset condition, lifecycle costs and renewal priorities with practical planning outputs. Explore this 5-day training course.
lede: Public asset management links asset information with condition, risk, service needs and funding across an asset’s life cycle. For asset managers, planners, and finance or operations practitioners, the course develops practical skills in checking asset registers, assessing condition, and prioritising risk, maintenance and renewal. Participants also compare lifecycle costs and prepare forecasts and management reports connecting service performance, costs and risks to funding choices.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who maintain public asset information or turn condition, service and cost evidence into maintenance and investment priorities.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public assets, infrastructure planning, maintenance operations or budget processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
